groups.title: Physical result · Student claim
groups.summary: Ready appears before a pickup code exists. A student claim asks the trusted server to issue or reuse one eligible code.

cases.title: Ready · no QR
cases.heading: Ready for pickup
cases.body: Your result is ready. Claim this request to get your pickup code.
notes: Before Realtime: request may show Processing. After an authorized Ready update: show this state with no QR.
Ready alone never issues a token or completes a request. Demo data only.

cases.title: Claim · generating
cases.heading: Preparing pickup code
cases.body: Keep this request open while we check that it can be claimed.
notes: External outcome: eligible trusted server issues a hashed, single-use token with configured expiry, or reuses the same still-valid token for repeated claims.
Fixture routes to pickup_issued, pickup_generation_failed, pickup_expiry_unavailable or pickup_uncertain; no provider call occurs.

cases.title: Claim · code issued
cases.heading: Show this at pickup
cases.body: Present your pickup code to the issuing office. Your request stays Ready until staff confirms handover.
notes: Render an unmistakable crossed placeholder, never a scannable QR or real secret.
Repeated claim before expiry returns the same valid code. TTL comes from approved server configuration; no duration is specified here.
After Realtime confirms completion, replace code with pickup_completed. Until then Ready remains visible.

cases.title: Claim · failed
cases.heading: Pickup code unavailable
cases.body: We could not prepare your code. Your request is still Ready.
notes: External retry must check for an existing valid code before issuing another. No token shown on failure.

cases.title: Claim · expiry not configured
cases.heading: Pickup code unavailable
cases.body: This office cannot issue a pickup code yet. Check this request again later.
notes: External prerequisite missing: approved expiry configuration. Fail closed; do not invent a TTL or issue an unbounded token.

cases.title: Claim · offline or lost response
cases.heading: Check your pickup code
cases.body: The connection stopped before we received a result. Reconnect to check whether your code is ready.
notes: External reconciliation reads authoritative state; reuse any valid issuance. Never label this definite failure or generate duplicate tokens because the response was lost.

cases.title: Physical · completed
cases.heading: Pickup completed
cases.body: The office confirmed that your result was handed over.
notes: Show only after authoritative confirmed handover. Realtime updates the request detail, list and relevant notification without exposing the token.

groups.title: Physical result · Staff handover
groups.summary: Scan or manual entry validates a code. Staff reviews the matching request and explicitly confirms actual handover before completion.

cases.title: Staff · scan
cases.heading: Scan pickup code
cases.body: Scan the student's pickup code to find the matching request.
notes: Prototype fixture only. Production camera requires permission. A scan never completes a request.

cases.title: Staff · camera denied
cases.heading: Camera access is off
cases.body: Enter the pickup code manually to continue.
notes: No permission change in prototype. Manual entry uses identical trusted-server checks.

cases.title: Staff · manual entry
cases.heading: Enter pickup code
cases.body: Use the code shown on the student's request.
notes: Visible fixture cannot validate in production. Manual input is not a request reference search or a completion override.

cases.title: Staff · validating
cases.heading: Checking pickup code
cases.body: Wait while we check the request and your office access.
notes: External validation checks token hash, validity, expiry, consumption, invalidation, Ready status and staff office authority.
Fixture routes to review or one of the explicit rejection states. Validation does not consume the token or complete the request.

cases.title: Staff · review matching request
cases.heading: Review before handover
cases.body: Check the matching request. Confirm only after you have handed the result to the student.
notes: Explicit confirmation is a separate action after review and actual handover. Opening review, scanning and cancellation leave Ready unchanged.
Do not invent institutional identity or pickup policies. Display only authorized matching-request data.

cases.title: Staff · confirming handover
cases.heading: Recording handover
cases.body: Wait for confirmation before leaving this request.
notes: External transaction rechecks all eligibility and atomically consumes the token, completes the request, and records actor/time.
Success routes to pickup_staff_completed; concurrent completion to pickup_already_completed; failure to pickup_handover_failed; lost response to pickup_handover_uncertain.

cases.title: Staff · completed
cases.heading: Handover recorded
cases.body: This request is Completed. The pickup code can no longer be used.
notes: Before Realtime: student can still show cached Ready. After authorized completion update: student shows pickup_completed. Server truth wins over cached screens.

cases.title: Staff · unknown code
cases.heading: Code not found
cases.body: Check the code and try again.
notes: No matching token. Do not reveal unrelated request or student data.

cases.title: Staff · expired code
cases.heading: Pickup code expired
cases.body: Ask the student to reopen their request and claim an available code.
notes: External student re-claim checks current eligibility and configured expiry. Expired token never completes a request; no invented renewal duration.

cases.title: Staff · reused code
cases.heading: Code already used
cases.body: This pickup code cannot be used again.
notes: Consumed-token rejection. Expose completion detail only if the staff member remains authorized to read that request.

cases.title: Staff · wrong office
cases.heading: Code cannot be used here
cases.body: This pickup is outside your office access. Ask the student to check the issuing office on their request.
notes: No cross-office request detail. Changing the UI office label does not grant authority.

cases.title: Staff · invalidated code
cases.heading: Code no longer valid
cases.body: Ask the student to check the latest details on their request.
notes: Server invalidated token; never reactivate locally or infer that another code must be available.

cases.title: Staff · request not Ready
cases.heading: Request is not ready
cases.body: This request cannot be handed over through pickup confirmation.
notes: Authoritative request is no longer Ready. A previously validated review must be rechecked at confirmation.

cases.title: Staff · validation unavailable
cases.heading: Could not check code
cases.body: Reconnect and check the code again before confirming handover.
notes: Network/server failure leaves token consumption and request status unchanged. Cached review cannot bypass validation.

cases.title: Staff · confirmation failed
cases.heading: Handover was not recorded
cases.body: Check the current request before trying to record the handover again.
notes: Use only for a definitive server failure. Preserve context that staff may already have physically handed over the result; retry records the same handover without asking for a second handover.

cases.title: Staff · confirmation response lost
cases.heading: Checking handover status
cases.body: The connection stopped before confirmation arrived. Check whether the handover was recorded.
notes: External reconciliation reads the authoritative result using the same operation identity before retry. Do not blindly consume again or ask for another physical handover.

cases.title: Staff · concurrent completion
cases.heading: Already completed
cases.body: Another confirmation completed this request. No second handover was recorded.
notes: Concurrency outcome after review or confirmation: one atomic completion only. Reconcile actor/time from authorized server data and update cached views.

groups.title: Digital result · Release and receipt
groups.summary: Office staff verifies and releases a private PDF. A successful download enables a separate student receipt confirmation.

cases.title: Office · select PDF
cases.heading: Prepare digital result
cases.body: Select the PDF for this request, then review it before release.
notes: External authorized private-file selection/upload fixture. No real picker, storage or provider operation. No public file URL.

cases.title: Office · verify private PDF
cases.heading: Verify PDF for release
cases.body: Check that this PDF belongs to the request and contains the intended result.
notes: Private preview is authorized to this office. Release requires explicit verification and server checks. Preview alone never marks Ready or Completed.

cases.title: Office · releasing
cases.heading: Releasing digital result
cases.body: Wait while the verified PDF is linked to this request.
notes: External outcome atomically authorizes a verified private PDF version and sets Ready for Download. Success routes to digital_released, failure to digital_release_failed.

cases.title: Office · release failed
cases.heading: PDF was not released
cases.body: Check the selected PDF and try again.
notes: No optimistic Ready state or notification. Lost release response requires authoritative reconciliation before any repeat write.

cases.title: Office · released
cases.heading: Digital result ready
cases.body: The student can download the verified PDF and confirm receipt.
notes: Before Realtime: student may see Processing. After authorized release update: digital_ready. Release does not complete the request.

cases.title: Student · Ready for Download
cases.heading: Your PDF is ready
cases.body: Download the PDF, then confirm when you have received this version.
notes: Receipt confirmation stays disabled before successful download. Opening the request or a PDF preview never completes it. Private access is rechecked by the server.

cases.title: Student · downloading
cases.heading: Downloading PDF
cases.body: Wait until the download finishes before confirming receipt.
notes: External outcome: actual successful download of authorized current version routes to digital_downloaded. Failure, stale version and access failure have separate outcomes. No invented percentage.

cases.title: Student · download failed
cases.heading: Download did not finish
cases.body: Your receipt has not been confirmed. Try downloading the PDF again.
notes: Incomplete download does not enable confirmation or complete the request.

cases.title: Student · downloaded
cases.heading: PDF downloaded
cases.body: Check your downloaded file. Confirm receipt when you have received this result.
notes: Successful download enables the explicit action for that version only. Downloading, reopening and viewing do not complete the request.

cases.title: Student · confirming receipt
cases.heading: Recording receipt
cases.body: Wait while we confirm receipt of this PDF version.
notes: External controlled action checks student ownership, current released version, authorized download prerequisite and Ready status. Success routes to digital_completed; stale to digital_stale; definite failure to digital_confirmation_failed; lost response to digital_checking.

cases.title: Student · receipt not recorded
cases.heading: Receipt was not recorded
cases.body: Your PDF remains downloaded. Try confirming receipt again.
notes: Definitive server rejection without completion. Recheck version and access on retry.

cases.title: Student · lost receipt response
cases.heading: Check receipt status
cases.body: The connection stopped before confirmation arrived. Check whether your receipt was recorded.

fields.label: Receipt status
fields.value: Not yet confirmed on this screen

notes: External reconciliation reads authoritative completion before retrying the same operation. Confirmed completion routes to digital_completed; unchanged current version returns digital_downloaded. Do not infer failure from a lost response.

cases.title: Student · replaced PDF version
cases.heading: A newer PDF is available
cases.body: Download the latest PDF before confirming receipt.
notes: External fixture carries version B into all following states. Clear version A receipt eligibility. Reject stale confirmation atomically if replacement happens after download or during confirmation.
Before Realtime: cached version A may still appear. After replacement update: invalidate local confirmation and show this state.

cases.title: Student · access denied
cases.heading: PDF access unavailable
cases.body: You do not have access to this digital result with the current account.
notes: External access revalidation required before displaying file metadata or enabling download. Unauthorized result must not expose another student's PDF or reusable URL.

cases.title: Student · file unavailable
cases.heading: PDF is unavailable
cases.body: We cannot retrieve the released file right now. Check again before confirming receipt.
notes: Missing, withdrawn or inaccessible current file cannot enable receipt confirmation. External revalidation determines Ready, stale or unavailable state.

cases.title: Digital · completed
cases.heading: Receipt confirmed
cases.body: Your receipt of the released PDF was recorded. This request is Completed.
notes: Only authoritative successful explicit receipt action reaches this state. After Realtime: authorized office list, student detail and notifications reflect Completed; download alone emits no completion.
All screens are static design fixtures in both themes. No fees, official policy wording, native code, backend changes or provider calls are specified.
